description: X-OOS-Preview v1 test vector (design 2026-10-26-cms-in-the-builder section 4.5). payloadSegment is base64url (no padding) of the UTF-8 JSON of payload, keys in the order org, sub, sid, iat, exp; mac is base64url (no padding) of HMAC-SHA256 keyed by secret over the ASCII bytes of payloadSegment; header is 'v1.' + payloadSegment + '.' + mac. iat and exp are Unix seconds. The secret is a test value only.
